Fixed: Fixed: MCP — Module catalogue was empty and knowledge files were corrupted in the Webstore and WPRio builds. The knowledge files now ship intact, so the full module list is available again.

Fixed: MCP — create-posts now enforces the selected post type's own permissions. Pages and internal types are refused, publishing needs that type's publish permission, and terms need assign-terms permission.
Fixed: Layout Importer — Only Theme Builder layout types can be imported, and the importing user must be allowed to create them.
Fixed: Popup CSV Import — A row can only publish if the user is allowed to publish popups; otherwise it is saved as a draft.
Fixed: Divi 5 Migration — Legacy Divi 4 shortcodes are now converted during migration, so the Backwards Compatibility Mode notice no longer appears.
